newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn ends firmer on rally in soy complex.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn ends firmer on rally in soy complex.

text.p: CBOT corn futures closed firmer on a rally in the soy complex, traders said.
But the market lacked significant direction after the recent return to near trendline support levels set in early February, they said.
But U.S. Midwest weather patterns were nearly ideal for crop growth and the market wasn't able to muster sponsorship for a bullish scenario.
Recent rainfall in the U.S. Midwest combined with warmer weather will boost corn production prospects, the traders said.
USDA Monday said the U.S. corn crop as of Sunday was rated 66 percent good to excellent, above the 65 percent in that category the previous week.
Cargill Inc sold three million December and bought three million July, traders said. FIMAT Futures sold two million December and Rosenthal Collins sold four million bushels of December, traders said.
Corn closed 1-3/4 cents per bushel higher to one lower, with July up 1-3/4 at $2.70-1/4.
